## Definition
DARPA's Electronics Resurgence Initiative 2.0, a strategic program funding full-chain innovations from materials and devices to system-level architectures for post-Moore computing. Provides the strategic roadmap and funding structure that drives TCC research toward novel interconnect, packaging, and neuromorphic chiplet integration.
